mapper.insert: insert into basket_player_cert_audit (application_id, audit_action, before_status, after_status, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{applicationId}, #{auditAction}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, #{auditRemark}, #{auditTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, application_id, audit_action, before_status, after_status, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_player_cert_audit where application_id = #{applicationId} and is_delete = 0 order by audit_time desc
